headline: Woodside and PEMEX sign MOU to expand Mexico deepwater partnership
dek: The two companies already share the $7.2 billion Trion deepwater project and now want to find more Gulf of Mexico prospects together.
body:
Woodside Energy and Petróleos Mexicanos signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding on September 3, 2026, to jointly assess new exploration and extraction opportunities in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico. The deal was inked in Mexico City after a sit-down between Woodside CEO Liz Westcott and PEMEX CEO Juan Carlos Carpio Fragoso.

The MOU also covers the exchange of technical knowledge, experience, and industry best practices between the two companies. It is non-binding, meaning neither side is locked into specific projects yet, but it sets a formal framework for what comes next.

The two firms are already deep into a joint venture. Woodside operates the Trion oil project with a 60% stake; PEMEX holds the other 40%. Trion sits roughly 180 kilometers off Mexico's coast and 30 kilometers south of the US-Mexico maritime border, at water depths of 2,500 to 2,600 meters in the Perdido Fold Belt. PEMEX discovered the field in 2012.

The project is built around 24 subsea wells feeding a 100,000 barrel-per-day floating production unit called Tláloc and a 950,000-barrel floating storage and offloading unit called Chalchi. As of June 30, 2026, construction was 64% complete. Total capital investment is forecast at $7.2 billion, with first oil targeted for 2028.

Over its lifetime, Trion is expected to deliver more than $10 billion in taxes and royalties to Mexico. The new MOU signals that both companies see the Gulf of Mexico deepwater as a longer-term growth corridor, not just a single-project play.
facts: Woodside Energy and Petróleos Mexicanos (PEMEX) signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding on September 3, 2026, to jointly assess future opportunities for exploration and extraction of hydrocarbons in the deepwater Gulf of Mexico. The MOU was signed in Mexico City following a meeting between Woodside CEO Liz Westcott and PEMEX CEO Juan Carlos Carpio Fragoso. The agreement will also facilitate the mutual exchange of technical knowledge, experience, and industry best practices in the oil and gas sector. The two companies are already jointly developing the Trion oil project, located approximately 180 kilometers off Mexico's coastline and 30 kilometers south of the US-Mexico maritime border. Woodside operates Trion with a 60% interest, while PEMEX holds the remaining 40%; the field was discovered by PEMEX in 2012. Trion, which lies in the Perdido Fold Belt at depths of 2,500–2,600 meters, is designed for 24 subsea wells connected to a 100,000 barrel-per-day floating production unit named Tláloc and a 950,000-barrel floating storage and offloading unit named Chalchi. The project was 64% complete as of June 30, 2026, with a forecast total capital investment of $7.2 billion and first oil targeted for 2028. Trion is expected to contribute more than $10 billion in taxes and royalties to Mexico over the life of the project.

es.headline: Epyca advierte que el endurecimiento financiero global amenaza la deuda y las exportaciones de Argentina
es.dek: La consultora argentina Epyca dice que el colapso de un acuerdo financiero global de décadas pone en riesgo directo los USD 40 mil millones en deuda de Argentina y sus exportaciones de materias primas.
es.body:
La consultora argentina Epyca Consultores advirtió el 5 de septiembre de 2026 que los cambios en el financiamiento global y la política monetaria de Estados Unidos amenazan la economía argentina en un momento en que el país cuenta con el crecimiento de las exportaciones para mantenerse solvente.

El núcleo del argumento: el arreglo que los economistas llaman Bretton Woods 2.0 se ha derrumbado. Durante décadas, los superávits comerciales de China y los países petroleros regresaban en forma de bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, manteniendo bajas las tasas de interés a largo plazo. Tras la pandemia de COVID-19, ese reciclaje se estancó. China ahora canaliza sus superávits hacia activos reales y proyectos de infraestructura en otros países en lugar de deuda estadounidense.

Un crédito global más restrictivo golpearía a Argentina en dos frentes a la vez. La estrategia exportadora del gobierno —construida sobre la agricultura, la minería, los hidrocarburos y la energía— deja al país expuesto a las fluctuaciones en los precios de las materias primas si los costos de endeudamiento suben y la demanda global se debilita. Al mismo tiempo, Argentina carga con obligaciones de deuda en moneda extranjera que superan los USD 40 mil millones, una mezcla de bonos soberanos reestructurados de la era de Martín Guzmán, préstamos multilaterales y deuda corporativa. Tasas globales más altas harían más difícil y más costoso refinanciar esa deuda.

Epyca también señala varios puntos de presión que podrían acelerar cualquier deterioro: una disputa abierta entre el Departamento del Tesoro de Estados Unidos y la Reserva Federal, grandes fondos extraterritoriales reposicionándose, una inflación sostenida en Estados Unidos que ya lleva cinco años y tensiones geopolíticas en torno a los mercados petroleros y la inteligencia artificial.

Para las empresas y los trabajadores argentinos, la pregunta práctica es si los ingresos por exportaciones podrán cubrir el servicio de la deuda si las condiciones globales se endurecen antes de que el país construya un colchón mayor de divisas. El informe de Epyca no predice una crisis, pero deja en claro con qué rapidez las variables externas podrían reducir las opciones de Argentina.

perspectives.position: El colapso de Bretton Woods 2.0 y el endurecimiento del crédito global exponen directamente la deuda de más de USD 40 mil millones de Argentina y su modelo exportador a riesgos crecientes.

headline: Epyca warns global financial tightening threatens Argentina's debt and exports
dek: Argentine consultancy Epyca says the collapse of a decades-old global financing arrangement puts Argentina's $40 billion debt pile and commodity exports at direct risk.
body:
Argentine consultancy Epyca Consultores warned on September 5, 2026, that shifts in global financing and U.S. monetary policy threaten Argentina's economy at a moment when the country is counting on export growth to stay solvent.

The core of the argument: the arrangement economists call Bretton Woods 2.0 has broken down. For decades, Chinese and oil-country trade surpluses flowed back into U.S. Treasury bonds, holding long-term interest rates low. After the COVID-19 pandemic, that recycling stalled. China now channels its surpluses into real assets and infrastructure projects in other countries instead of U.S. debt.

Tighter global credit would hit Argentina in two places at once. The government's export strategy—built on agriculture, mining, hydrocarbons and energy—leaves the country exposed to commodity-price swings if borrowing costs rise and global demand softens. At the same time, Argentina carries foreign-currency debt obligations exceeding USD 40 billion, a mix of restructured sovereign bonds from the Martín Guzmán era, multilateral loans and corporate debt. Higher global rates would make refinancing that pile harder and more expensive.

Epyca also flags several pressure points that could speed up any deterioration: an open dispute between the U.S. Treasury and the Federal Reserve, large offshore funds repositioning, sustained U.S. inflation running five years now, and geopolitical tensions around oil markets and artificial intelligence.

For Argentine businesses and workers, the practical question is whether export revenues can cover debt service if global conditions tighten before the country builds a larger hard-currency cushion. Epyca's report does not predict a crisis, but it lays out clearly how quickly external variables could narrow Argentina's options.
facts: A September 5, 2026 report by Argentine consultancy Epyca Consultores warns that shifts in global financing and U.S. monetary policy pose direct risks to Argentina's economy. Epyca argues that the model sustaining global finances for decades broke down in 2026: under the so-called Bretton Woods 2.0 arrangement, Chinese and oil-country surpluses were recycled into U.S. Treasury bonds, keeping long-term rates low. After the COVID-19 pandemic that mechanism stalled, and China now redirects its surpluses to real assets and infrastructure in other countries rather than U.S. debt. The Argentine government's strategy of boosting exports from agriculture, mining, hydrocarbons and energy increases the country's exposure to international commodity-price swings if global credit tightens. Argentina also faces foreign-currency debt obligations exceeding USD 40 billion, comprising restructured sovereign bonds from the Martín Guzmán era, multilateral loans and corporate debt. A potential rise in global borrowing costs could impair Argentina's ability to refinance those obligations. The report also flags the dispute between the U.S. Treasury and the Federal Reserve, the behavior of large offshore funds, sustained U.S. inflation over five years and the geopolitics of oil and artificial intelligence as additional factors that could accelerate financial deterioration.

es.headline: Cruz Azul vs Santos Laguna cambia de horario; Erik Lira se queda en el club
es.dek: La Liga MX adelantó tres horas el partido Cruz Azul–Santos para dejar libre la señal para la final de la Leagues Cup en Houston.
es.body:
Cruz Azul y Santos Laguna arrancarán a las 17:00 hrs el domingo 6 de septiembre, y no a las 20:00 hrs como estaba programado originalmente. La Liga MX adelantó tres horas el partido de la Jornada 7 del Apertura 2026 para evitar que se empatara con la transmisión de la final de la Leagues Cup entre Toluca y Monterrey, fijada para las 19:15 hrs esa misma noche en el Shell Energy Stadium de Houston. La sede no cambia: será el Estadio Banorte en la Ciudad de México.

La Liga MX anunció el cambio en sus canales oficiales de redes sociales. El partido no fue postergado a otra fecha: solo se movió el horario de inicio. Otros cuatro juegos de la Jornada 7 no corrieron con la misma suerte: Puebla vs. Toluca, Querétaro vs. Monterrey, América vs. Tijuana y Pumas vs. León fueron aplazados por completo a fechas posteriores debido a conflictos de programación con la Leagues Cup.

Cruz Azul llega al partido del domingo en el décimo lugar de la tabla del Apertura 2026 con nueve puntos en seis jornadas. El equipo viene de una victoria 3-1 sobre Necaxa, así que llega con impulso a un partido de local.

También se confirmó esta semana: el mediocampista Erik Lira se queda. Cruz Azul anunció que Lira continuará con el plantel para el Apertura 2026 luego de que su traspaso al AS Monaco se cayera. El Monaco no pudo abrir un cupo de registro para jugadores extranjeros antes de que cerrara la ventana de transferencias de verano, lo que echó abajo el acuerdo.

Para los aficionados de Santos Laguna que viajen al partido, el horario más temprano es el único cambio logístico. Para Cruz Azul, contar con Lira disponible suma profundidad en la línea media justo cuando el club busca escalar en la tabla.

perspectives.position: Adelantó el partido Cruz Azul–Santos tres horas para evitar el traslape de transmisiones con la final de la Leagues Cup.
Anunció que Erik Lira permanecerá en el equipo para el Apertura 2026 tras el fracaso de su traspaso al AS Monaco.
Deben ajustar sus planes de viaje al nuevo horario de las 17:00 hrs del domingo 6 de septiembre.

headline: Cruz Azul vs Santos Laguna kickoff moved; Erik Lira stays at club
dek: Liga MX moved the Cruz Azul–Santos kickoff three hours earlier to clear the airwaves for the Leagues Cup final in Houston.
body:
Cruz Azul and Santos Laguna will kick off at 17:00 hrs on Sunday, September 6 — not 20:00 hrs as originally scheduled. Liga MX shifted the Jornada 7 Apertura 2026 match three hours earlier to avoid broadcasting overlap with the Leagues Cup final between Toluca and Monterrey, set for 19:15 hrs that same evening at Shell Energy Stadium in Houston. The venue stays the same: Estadio Banorte in Mexico City.

Liga MX posted the change on its official social media channels. This game was not postponed to another date — only the kickoff time moved. Four other Jornada 7 fixtures were not so lucky: Puebla vs. Toluca, Querétaro vs. Monterrey, América vs. Tijuana, and Pumas vs. León were pushed entirely to later dates because of Leagues Cup scheduling conflicts.

Cruz Azul goes into Sunday's match sitting 10th in the Apertura 2026 table with nine points through six matchdays. The club is coming off a 3-1 win over Necaxa, so momentum is there heading into a home game.

Also confirmed this week: midfielder Erik Lira is staying put. Cruz Azul announced Lira will remain with the squad for Apertura 2026 after a move to AS Monaco collapsed. Monaco could not open a foreign-player registration slot before the summer transfer window closed, killing the deal.

For Santos Laguna supporters making the trip, the earlier start time is the only logistical change. For Cruz Azul, having Lira available adds depth at midfield just as the club pushes to climb the standings.
facts: Liga MX announced that the Jornada 7 Apertura 2026 match between Cruz Azul and Santos Laguna, originally scheduled for 20:00 hrs on Sunday, September 6, was moved up three hours to 17:00 hrs at Estadio Banorte in Mexico City. The schedule change was made to avoid overlap with the Leagues Cup final between Toluca and Monterrey, set for 19:15 hrs the same day at Shell Energy Stadium in Houston. The Cruz Azul vs Santos game was not postponed to a different date; only the kickoff time was adjusted, with the venue unchanged. Liga MX announced the change via its official social media channels. Four other Jornada 7 matches—Puebla vs. Toluca, Querétaro vs. Monterrey, América vs. Tijuana, and Pumas vs. León—were postponed entirely to later dates to avoid conflicts with the Leagues Cup. Separately, Cruz Azul confirmed that midfielder Erik Lira would remain with the club for the Apertura 2026 after his transfer to AS Monaco fell through because Monaco could not free up a foreign-player registration slot before the summer transfer window closed. Cruz Azul enters the Santos match in 10th place in the Apertura 2026 standings with nine points after six matchdays, having won its most recent game 3-1 over Necaxa.

es.headline: El informe de empleos de agosto agrega 162,000 puestos; las mujeres capturan casi todas las ganancias
es.dek: El informe de empleos de agosto superó ampliamente los pronósticos, pero las mujeres obtuvieron casi todas las ganancias mientras que el crecimiento salarial alcanzó su ritmo más lento en cinco años.
es.body:
WASHINGTON — Los empleadores agregaron 162,000 empleos en nóminas no agrícolas en agosto, superando con creces las estimaciones de los economistas de aproximadamente 55,000 a 56,000, informó la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales el 5 de septiembre. La tasa de desempleo se mantuvo en 4.1%, con las mujeres adultas en 3.5% y los hombres adultos en 4.0%, según datos de la BLS.

Las mujeres representaron 158,000 de los 162,000 empleos agregados en agosto, o aproximadamente el 98%, según un análisis de CNBC de los datos de la BLS. Desde enero de 2025, el empleo acumulado en nómina de las mujeres ha aumentado en aproximadamente 765,000, mientras que el empleo de los hombres ha caído en aproximadamente 6,000, según Mike Konczal, director de política e investigación del Economic Security Project. La BLS también revisó al alza las cifras de nómina de junio y julio en un total combinado de 55,000 empleos, incluida una revisión de la cifra de julio de -23,000 a +21,000.

Las ganancias promedio por hora aumentaron un 3.1% en el año, el ritmo anual más lento desde mayo de 2021, y la participación en la fuerza laboral ha caído medio punto porcentual desde enero de 2025, según el Daily Wire. La calificación de aprobación económica de Trump se situó en 32% a mediados del verano, en comparación con el 50% en el mismo punto de su primer mandato, según encuestas de AP-NORC.

El director del Consejo Económico Nacional, Kevin Hassett, calificó el informe de 'extraordinario'. El presidente Trump publicó en Truth Social que los números superaron todas las estimaciones 'por el doble y el triple' y usó el resultado para exigir que la Reserva Federal baje las tasas de interés de inmediato, según NBC News y The Blaze. Trump también dirigió críticas a la Reserva Federal y a los mercados financieros ante la noción de que unas ganancias sólidas en el empleo podrían contribuir a presiones inflacionarias, según AP y NBC News.

El representante Bobby Scott, demócrata de Virginia y miembro de alto rango del Comité de Educación y Fuerza Laboral de la Cámara, dijo en un comunicado que 'la economía del presidente Trump no está funcionando para los trabajadores', citando que la inflación supera el crecimiento salarial y que los trabajadores se llevan a casa una porción menor de la economía que en cualquier momento en 70 años, según Fox Business.

headline: August jobs report adds 162,000, women take nearly all gains
dek: The August jobs report vastly exceeded forecasts, but women captured nearly all gains while wage growth hit its slowest pace in five years.
body:
WASHINGTON — Employers added 162,000 nonfarm payroll jobs in August, far surpassing economist estimates of roughly 55,000 to 56,000, the Bureau of Labor Statistics reported Sept. 5. The unemployment rate held at 4.1%, with adult women at 3.5% and adult men at 4.0%, according to BLS data.

Women accounted for 158,000 of the 162,000 jobs added in August, or approximately 98%, according to a CNBC analysis of BLS data. Since January 2025, women's cumulative payroll employment has risen by roughly 765,000 while men's employment is down about 6,000, according to Mike Konczal, director of policy and research at the Economic Security Project. The BLS also revised June and July payroll figures upward by a combined 55,000 jobs, including a revision of July's figure from -23,000 to +21,000.

Average hourly earnings rose 3.1% over the year, the slowest annual pace since May 2021, and labor force participation has fallen half a percentage point since January 2025, according to the Daily Wire. Trump's economic approval rating stood at 32% in mid-summer, compared with 50% at the same point in his first term, according to AP-NORC polling.

National Economic Council director Kevin Hassett called the report a 'blockbuster.' President Trump posted on Truth Social that the numbers broke all estimates 'by double and triple' and used the result to demand the Federal Reserve lower interest rates immediately, according to NBC News and The Blaze. Trump also directed criticism at the Federal Reserve and financial markets over the notion that strong job gains could contribute to inflationary pressures, according to AP and NBC News.

Rep. Bobby Scott, D-Va., ranking member of the House Education and Workforce Committee, said in a statement that 'President Trump's economy is not working for workers,' citing inflation outpacing wage growth and workers taking home a smaller share of the economy than at any point in 70 years, according to Fox Business.
facts: The Bureau of Labor Statistics released the August 2026 Employment Situation report on September 5, showing employers added 162,000 nonfarm payroll jobs, well above economist estimates of roughly 55,000–56,000 (AP, Fox Business, CNBC). The unemployment rate held at 4.1%, with adult women at 3.5% and adult men at 4.0% (BLS). Women accounted for 158,000 of the 162,000 jobs added in August, or approximately 98%, according to a CNBC analysis of BLS data. Since January 2025, women's cumulative payroll employment has risen by roughly 765,000 while men's employment is down about 6,000, according to Mike Konczal, director of policy and research at the Economic Security Project. The BLS revised June and July payroll figures up by a combined 55,000 jobs; July's figure was revised from -23,000 to +21,000 (BLS). Average hourly earnings rose 3.1% over the year, the slowest annual pace since May 2021, and labor force participation has fallen half a percentage point since January 2025 (Daily Wire). Trump's economic approval rating stood at 32% in mid-summer, according to AP-NORC polling, compared with 50% at the same point in his first term (AP). Speaking from the Oval Office, Trump called the report 'great' on Truth Social but also directed criticism at the Federal Reserve and financial markets, objecting to the notion that strong job gains could contribute to inflationary pressures (AP, NBC News).

es.headline: Messi listo para titular cuando Inter Miami recibe a Atlanta United
es.dek: Messi arranca el sábado tras una actuación de cuatro goles y una asistencia ante Montréal, cuando el Inter Miami, segundo en la tabla, recibe al Atlanta United, que ocupa el puesto 27.
es.body:
Lionel Messi está listo para ser titular cuando el Inter Miami CF reciba al Atlanta United en el Nu Stadium el sábado 5 de septiembre de 2026, con patada inicial a las 7:30 p.m. ET. Llega al partido liderando la carrera por la Bota de Oro de la MLS tras anotar cuatro goles y añadir una asistencia en una paliza de 7-1 al CF Montréal — su primera actuación de cuatro goles en la MLS. Ese esfuerzo le valió el premio al Jugador de la Jornada.

El Inter Miami (12-4-6, 42 puntos) se ubica segundo en la Conferencia Este. El Atlanta United es 27.° en la clasificación general con 21 puntos, lo que hace de este un desajuste evidente sobre el papel. El entrenador interino Guillermo Hoyos sigue al mando; el técnico entrante Cristian 'Kily' González aún espera su permiso de trabajo.

Tres bajas marcarán el once de Miami. Sergio Reguilón, Gonzalo Luján y Micael son todos baja por lesiones en el tren inferior, según el periodista José Armando. El peso de esas ausencias recaerá sobre un equipo que ya gestiona un calendario sobrecargado.

Más allá del sábado, hay interrogantes sobre el futuro de Messi. Firmó una extensión de contrato hasta diciembre de 2028 en octubre de 2025, pero ha insinuado públicamente que el retiro podría no estar muy lejos. En una emotiva publicación tras la muerte de su padre, expresó dudas sobre si seguirá jugando mucho más tiempo. Ya se retiró de la selección argentina, concentrando su enfoque en el fútbol de clubes. Un exjugador de la MLS ha pronosticado que Messi seguirá en el Inter Miami en 2028, aunque el propio jugador ha dejado la puerta abierta.

Por ahora, el foco está en Atlanta. Una victoria de Miami reforzaría su dominio en la Conferencia Este y llevaría a Messi aún más adelante en la clasificación de la Bota de Oro.

perspectives.position: Entrenador interino a cargo del Inter Miami en ausencia de Cristian 'Kily' González, quien aún espera su permiso de trabajo.

headline: Messi set to start as Inter Miami host Atlanta United
dek: Messi starts Saturday after a four-goal, one-assist performance against Montréal as second-place Inter Miami host 27th-place Atlanta United.
body:
Lionel Messi is set to start when Inter Miami CF host Atlanta United at Nu Stadium on Saturday, September 5, 2026, kickoff 7:30 p.m. ET. He enters the match leading the MLS Golden Boot race after scoring four goals and adding an assist in a 7-1 rout of CF Montréal — his first four-goal MLS performance. That effort earned him Player of the Matchday honors.

Inter Miami (12-4-6, 42 points) sit second in the Eastern Conference. Atlanta United are 27th overall with 21 points, making this a mismatch on paper. Interim head coach Guillermo Hoyos remains in charge; incoming coach Cristian 'Kily' Gonzalez is still waiting on his work permit.

Three absences will shape Miami's lineup. Sergio Reguilon, Gonzalo Lujan, and Micael are all out with lower-body injuries, according to journalist José Armando. The depth of those losses will fall on a squad already managing a congested schedule.

Beyond Saturday, questions hang over Messi's future. He signed a contract extension through December 2028 in October 2025, but has hinted publicly that retirement may not be far off. In an emotional post following his father's death, he expressed doubts about playing much longer. He has already retired from international duty with Argentina, narrowing his focus to club football. A former MLS player has predicted Messi will still be at Inter Miami in 2028, though the player himself has left the door open.

For now, the focus is on Atlanta. A Miami win would tighten their grip on the Eastern Conference and push Messi further ahead in the Golden Boot standings.

Lionel Messi is expected to start the match, with interim head coach Guillermo Hoyos still in charge while incoming coach Cristian 'Kily' Gonzalez awaits his work permit. Messi enters the match in exceptional form after scoring four goals and adding an assist in Inter Miami's 7-1 rout of CF Montréal, earning Player of the Matchday honors. The result was Messi's first four-goal MLS performance, and it gave him the lead in the MLS Golden Boot race. Inter Miami (12-4-6, 42 points) sit second in the Eastern Conference, while Atlanta United are 27th with 21 points. Inter Miami will be without Sergio Reguilon, Gonzalo Lujan, and Micael due to lower-body injuries, according to journalist José Armando. Questions have been raised about whether Messi will honor his contract through 2028; he signed an extension with Inter Miami through December 2028 in October 2025, but has hinted publicly that retirement may not be far off. A former MLS player predicted Messi will still be at Inter Miami in 2028, while Messi himself, in an emotional post following his father's death, expressed doubts about continuing to play much longer.

es.headline: El voto latino se vuelve independiente mientras Valadao enfrenta un distrito reconfigurado
es.dek: Sondeos muestran que la identificación partidaria latina se desplaza hacia el estatus independiente mientras el representante David Valadao navega un distrito redibujado con una ventaja demócrata de 16 puntos en el registro electoral.
es.body:
FRESNO, California — El representante David Valadao (R-CA) busca la reelección en un distrito donde dos de cada tres votantes son hispanos, una demografía que según las encuestas se aleja de ambos partidos mayoritarios al mismo tiempo que su propia posición se vuelve más precaria.

Sondeos de AP-NORC muestran que el índice de aprobación de Trump entre los adultos hispanos cayó 18 puntos porcentuales entre marzo de 2025 y julio de 2026, el doble de la caída de 9 puntos registrada entre los adultos estadounidenses en general durante el mismo período. El distrito de Valadao también tiene una ventaja de 16 puntos en el registro demócrata tras la aprobación en 2025 por parte de los votantes del mapa de redistritación congresional del gobernador Gavin Newsom.

El estratega republicano Mike Madrid le dijo a AP que el clima político 'may be impossible for Valadao to survive' y que 'the fundamentals of the race point toward an anti-incumbent mood based off of souring economics.' Valadao, quien votó por el impeachment de Trump tras el 6 de enero y sería el último republicano de la Cámara en haberlo hecho si es reelecto, rechazó esa evaluación. 'I've won in these types of races', le dijo a AP.

Una investigación presentada en una videoconferencia organizada por American Community Media añadió otra variable. María Isabel Di Franco Quiñonez, directora sénior de investigación en Equis Research, dijo que sondeos de principios de 2025 mostraban una disminución en la identificación latina con el Partido Demócrata y un movimiento hacia el estatus de votante independiente. Les dijo a los participantes del encuentro que aproximadamente el 14 por ciento de los votantes latinos que apoyaron a Trump en 2024 ahora dicen que apoyarían a un demócrata en noviembre de 2026, con un 10 por ciento adicional que permanece indeciso.

S. Chad Peace, asesor legal del Independent Voter Project, estimó ante Latino News Network que aproximadamente tres de cada 10 votantes latinos registrados no están afiliados a ninguno de los dos partidos mayoritarios. 'This is a choice, not apathy', dijo Peace.

perspectives.position: Valadao dice que no está en pánico y que ya ha ganado en carreras como esta antes.
Madrid dice que el distrito tiene todo en contra del titular republicano y que los fundamentos apuntan hacia un ambiente antiincumbente impulsado por las condiciones económicas.

headline: Latino voters grow independent as Valadao faces shifting district
dek: Polling shows Latino party identification shifting toward independent status as Rep. David Valadao navigates a redrawn district with a 16-point Democratic registration edge.
body:
FRESNO, Calif. — Rep. David Valadao (R-CA) is running for reelection in a district where two out of three voters are Hispanic, a demographic that polling indicates is moving away from both major parties at the same time his own standing grows more precarious.

AP-NORC polling shows Trump's approval rating among Hispanic adults fell 18 percentage points between March 2025 and July 2026, double the 9-point drop recorded among U.S. adults overall during the same period. Valadao's district also carries a 16-point Democratic registration advantage following voters' 2025 approval of Gov. Gavin Newsom's congressional redistricting map.

Republican strategist Mike Madrid told AP that the political climate 'may be impossible for Valadao to survive' and that 'the fundamentals of the race point toward an anti-incumbent mood based off of souring economics.' Valadao, who voted for Trump's impeachment after January 6 and would be the last House Republican to have done so if reelected, pushed back on that assessment. 'I've won in these types of races,' he told AP.

Research presented at a videoconference organized by American Community Media added another variable. María Isabel Di Franco Quiñonez, senior research director at Equis Research, said early 2025 polling showed Latino identification with the Democratic Party declining and movement toward independent voter status. She told the briefing that roughly 14 percent of Latino voters who supported Trump in 2024 now say they would support a Democrat in November 2026, with an additional 10 percent remaining undecided.

S. Chad Peace, legal counsel for the Independent Voter Project, estimated to Latino News Network that roughly three in 10 registered Latino voters are not affiliated with either major party. 'This is a choice, not apathy,' Peace said.

AP reports Valadao voted for Trump's impeachment after January 6 and, if reelected, would be the last House Republican to have done so. AP reports Valadao's district carries a 16-point Democratic registration advantage following voters' 2025 approval of Gov. Gavin Newsom's congressional redistricting map. es.headline: Candidatos republicanos se distancian silenciosamente de Trump antes de las elecciones de noviembre
es.dek: Al menos siete candidatos republicanos a la Cámara han eliminado discretamente las referencias a Trump de sus sitios web de campaña, incluso cuando el expresidente planea un masivo despliegue de gastos para las elecciones intermedias.
es.body:
WASHINGTON — Al menos siete candidatos republicanos a la Cámara en contiendas reñidas han minimizado o eliminado las menciones al expresidente Donald Trump y sus prioridades de sus sitios web de campaña antes de las elecciones generales de noviembre, según informó The Washington Post.

Entre esos candidatos se encuentra el aspirante republicano al Congreso por Texas Carlos De La Cruz, quien reemplazó la frase 'TRUMP CONSERVATIVE' en su sitio web por 'PROVEN CONSERVATIVE', de acuerdo con el Post. La campaña de De La Cruz rechazó cualquier sugerencia de que se estaba alejando del presidente, cuya capacidad para movilizar a sus seguidores sigue siendo fundamental para los republicanos en general.

El silencioso reposicionamiento ocurre mientras Trump avanza en dirección contraria. Axios informó el 5 de septiembre que Trump está recorriendo la pista de campaña y enmarcando los 59 días que quedan antes de las elecciones intermedias del 3 de noviembre como un referéndum sobre él mismo. Trump dijo a los periodistas el viernes que su súper PAC y su organización política sin fines de lucro tienen en conjunto aproximadamente $800 millones, y que planea destinar '$400–$500 millones' a las elecciones intermedias, afirmando: 'I can spend it for what I want to spend it for', según Axios. Trump también quiere organizar lo que Axios describió como una convención de elecciones intermedias sin precedentes en Dallas del 9 al 10 de septiembre, con anuncios y eventos centrados en él.

Axios informó que el índice de aprobación de Trump entre los republicanos ha caído a un mínimo de segundo mandato del 79 por ciento, según el relato de Raw Story sobre el informe de Axios, y que la mayoría de los republicanos son demasiado reacios a decirle directamente a Trump lo impopular que se ha vuelto en ciertos distritos. Algunas campañas republicanas le han dicho al equipo de Trump que no quieren que el presidente visite sus distritos, y asesores han aconsejado a algunos candidatos evitar mencionar a Trump en sus discursos de campaña, según informes citados por MEAWW.

Un alto funcionario republicano de campaña resumió la posición del partido ante Axios en términos contundentes: 'We have no choice. We're stuck on the boat with him whether we like it or not.' Axios informó que los republicanos necesitan que los votantes de baja participación de Trump acudan a las urnas, lo que lleva a muchos a aceptar una estrategia centrada en Trump que en privado creen podría costarle al partido escaños tanto en la Cámara como en el Senado.

headline: GOP candidates quietly distance from Trump ahead of November midterms
dek: At least seven GOP House candidates have quietly scrubbed Trump references from campaign websites even as the former president plans a massive midterm spending blitz.
body:
WASHINGTON — At least seven Republican House candidates in battleground races have de-emphasized or removed mentions of former President Donald Trump and his priorities from their campaign websites ahead of the November general election, The Washington Post reported.

Among those candidates is Texas Republican congressional contender Carlos De La Cruz, who replaced the phrase 'TRUMP CONSERVATIVE' on his website with 'PROVEN CONSERVATIVE,' according to the Post. De La Cruz's campaign rejected any suggestion he was backing away from the president, whose ability to mobilize loyalists remains critical for Republicans broadly.

The quiet repositioning comes as Trump is moving in the opposite direction. Axios reported September 5 that Trump is hitting the campaign trail and framing the 59 days remaining before the November 3 midterms as a referendum on himself. Trump told reporters Friday that his super PAC and political nonprofit together hold approximately $800 million, and that he plans to direct '$400–$500 million' toward the midterms, saying, 'I can spend it for what I want to spend it for,' per Axios. Trump also wants to host what Axios described as an unprecedented midterm convention in Dallas on September 9–10, with ads and events centered on him.

Axios reported that Trump's approval rating among Republicans has fallen to a second-term low of 79 percent, per Raw Story's account of the Axios report, and that most Republicans are too reluctant to tell Trump directly how unpopular he has become in certain districts. Some Republican campaigns have told Trump's team they do not want the president to visit their districts, and advisers have counseled some candidates to avoid mentioning Trump in campaign speeches, according to reporting cited by MEAWW.

A top Republican campaign official summarized the party's position to Axios in blunt terms: 'We have no choice. We're stuck on the boat with him whether we like it or not.' Axios reported that Republicans need Trump's low-propensity voters to turn out, leading many to accept a Trump-focused strategy that they privately believe could cost the party seats in both the House and Senate.

Texas Republican congressional candidate Carlos De La Cruz, for example, replaced the phrase 'TRUMP CONSERVATIVE' on his website with 'PROVEN CONSERVATIVE'; his campaign rejected any suggestion he was backing away from the president, according to the Post. Axios reported on September 5 that Trump is hitting the campaign trail and making the 59 days to the November 3 midterms a referendum on himself, and that most Republicans are too scared to bluntly tell Trump how unpopular he is. Axios also reported that Republicans need Trump's low-propensity voters to turn out, and so are going along with a Trump-focused strategy that many believe could cost them seats in the House and Senate. Some Republican campaigns have told Trump's team they do not want the president to visit their districts, and advisers have told some candidates to avoid mentioning Trump in campaign speeches, according to reporting cited by MEAWW.

es.headline: Argentina abre el Mundial Femenino Sub-20 ante Polonia anfitriona en Katowice
es.dek: Polonia y Argentina inauguraron el torneo de 24 equipos en Katowice el 5 de septiembre, con la crisis de liderazgo de la FIFA sobrevolando la ceremonia de apertura.
es.body:
Katowice, Polonia — La Copa Mundial Femenina Sub-20 de la FIFA 2026 arrancó el 5 de septiembre en el Arena Katowice, con la nación anfitriona Polonia enfrentando a Argentina en el partido inaugural del torneo. La competencia se extiende hasta el 27 de septiembre en cuatro ciudades polacas: Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź y Sosnowiec.

El presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, estuvo en las gradas para el partido de apertura, donde fue visto conversando con el presidente de la federación polaca de fútbol, Cezary Kulesza. Cuando reporteros de Sky News intentaron preguntarle a Infantino sobre su futuro como presidente de la FIFA, los esquivó y dijo que habría un lugar y momento indicados para abordar la pregunta.

El torneo casi se desmorona antes de comenzar. Las naciones europeas —seis de los 24 equipos en competencia, es decir, una cuarta parte del campo— habían amenazado con boicotear el evento por el plan de Infantino de redirigir las ganancias del Mundial. Ese plan se derrumbó tras la amplia oposición de las naciones miembro de la FIFA y de algunos de los propios funcionarios de Infantino. Los equipos europeos cedieron apenas la semana pasada, luego de que la FIFA garantizara que el esquema de reparto de ganancias no sería revivido.

Las consecuencias legales del plan original siguen activas. La UEFA encabeza un esfuerzo para destituir a Infantino antes de las elecciones presidenciales de la FIFA el próximo año, manteniendo la presión sobre el liderazgo de la federación incluso mientras la competencia en la cancha da inicio.

Para Argentina, el partido inaugural ante Polonia ofreció un escenario de alto perfil frente a una multitud local parcial. Con 24 equipos compitiendo a lo largo de 22 días, la fase de grupos determinará qué selecciones avanzan hacia la final del 27 de septiembre. Los resultados en Katowice y las otras tres ciudades sede irán definiendo el cuadro en las próximas semanas.

headline: Argentina opens U20 Women's World Cup against host Poland in Katowice
dek: Poland and Argentina kicked off the 24-team tournament in Katowice on September 5, with FIFA's leadership crisis hovering over the opening ceremony.
body:
Katowice, Poland — The 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup got underway September 5 at Arena Katowice, with host nation Poland taking on Argentina in the tournament's opening match. The competition runs through September 27 across four Polish cities: Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź, and Sosnowiec.

FIFA President Gianni Infantino was in the stands for the opener, where he was spotted talking with Polish soccer federation president Cezary Kulesza. When Sky News reporters tried to ask Infantino about his future as FIFA president, he brushed them off, saying there would be a right place and time to address the question.

The tournament nearly fell apart before it started. European nations — six of the 24 competing teams, or one quarter of the field — had threatened to boycott over Infantino's plan to redirect World Cup profits. That plan collapsed after widespread opposition from FIFA member nations and some of Infantino's own officials. The European teams backed down only last week, after FIFA gave assurances the profit-sharing scheme would not be revived.

The legal fallout from the original plan is still active. UEFA is leading a push to oust Infantino before next year's FIFA presidential election, keeping pressure on the federation's leadership even as the on-field competition begins.

For Argentina, the opening match against Poland offered a high-profile stage in front of a partisan home crowd. With 24 teams competing over 22 days, the group stage will determine which sides advance toward the September 27 final. Results from Katowice and the three other host cities will shape the bracket in the coming weeks.
facts: The 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup opened on September 5 in Katowice, Poland, with host nation Poland facing Argentina in the tournament's first match at Arena Katowice. The 24-team tournament, running September 5–27, is being hosted by Poland across four cities: Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź, and Sosnowiec. FIFA President Gianni Infantino attended the opening match and was seen in the stands speaking with Polish soccer federation president Cezary Kulesza. Infantino declined to answer questions about his future as FIFA president, telling Sky News there would be a right place and time to address those matters. Infantino has faced continuing pressure since abandoning a plan to sell off World Cup profits, which collapsed amid opposition from many FIFA member nations and some of his own officials. European nations — a quarter of the 24-team field — had threatened a boycott of the tournament but backed down last week after receiving assurances from FIFA that the profit-sharing plan would not be revived. Legal action related to the original plan continues, and UEFA is playing a leading role in efforts to remove Infantino ahead of next year's FIFA presidential election.

es.headline: Uruguay convoca una sólida nómina para su gira por Asia y amistoso ante India
es.dek: Diego Forlán llama a 46 jugadores para los amistosos ante Japón, Corea del Sur e India, con el partido en Kolkata programado para el 6 de octubre.
es.body:
46 jugadores. Ese es el tamaño de la nómina provisional que Uruguay anunció el 5 de septiembre de 2026 para una gira por Asia con amistosos ante Japón, Corea del Sur e India. El partido ante India está confirmado para el 6 de octubre en el Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan —el Salt Lake Stadium— en Kolkata.

La nómina es la primera convocatoria de Diego Forlán, quien asume como entrenador principal de la selección mayor de Uruguay tras la renuncia de Marcelo Bielsa después de la eliminación del equipo en la fase de grupos del Mundial de la FIFA 2026. Forlán, ganador del Balón de Oro del Mundial 2010 y campeón de la Copa América 2011, llega a un proceso de reconstrucción con nombres conocidos a su disposición.

El capitán del Real Madrid, Federico Valverde, de 28 años, encabeza el grupo. Bicampeón de la UEFA Champions League, Valverde jugó los tres partidos de Uruguay en el Mundial 2026. El defensor Ronald Araujo también está incluido. El tres veces campeón de La Liga llegó al Liverpool en calidad de cedido por el Barcelona por una temporada en agosto de 2026. El delantero del Liverpool Darwin Núñez figura entre los atacantes.

La lista ampliada suma a Rodrigo Bentancur, Lucas Torreira, Giorgian de Arrascaeta, Facundo Pellistri, José María Giménez, Nahitan Nández y Mathías Olivera.

La nómina de 46 jugadores aún debe reducirse a una lista viajera de 26, y las autorizaciones de los clubes podrían modificar el grupo final antes de la partida. No se ha confirmado ningún plazo para ese anuncio. Para los aficionados al fútbol indio, la fecha del 6 de octubre en Kolkata es la que hay que tener marcada: un Uruguay de máximo nivel en el Salt Lake Stadium sería un encuentro poco habitual en el subcontinente.

perspectives.position: Entrenador principal de la selección de Uruguay, convoca a 46 jugadores para su primera nómina al frente del equipo mayor.
El partido del 6 de octubre en el Salt Lake Stadium de Kolkata representa una rara oportunidad de ver a Uruguay en el subcontinente.

headline: Uruguay names strong squad for Asia tour and India friendly
dek: Diego Forlán names 46 players for friendlies against Japan, South Korea, and India, with the Kolkata match set for October 6.
body:
46 players. That is the size of the provisional squad Uruguay announced on September 5, 2026, for an Asia tour featuring friendlies against Japan, South Korea, and India. The India match is locked in for October 6 at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan — Salt Lake Stadium — in Kolkata.

The squad is the first selection from Diego Forlán, who takes charge as Uruguay's senior head coach after Marcelo Bielsa resigned following the team's group-stage exit at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Forlán, the 2010 World Cup Golden Ball winner and 2011 Copa América champion, steps into a rebuilding job with familiar names at his disposal.

Real Madrid captain Federico Valverde, 28, headlines the group. A two-time UEFA Champions League winner, Valverde started all three of Uruguay's matches at the 2026 World Cup. Defender Ronald Araujo is also included. The three-time La Liga winner joined Liverpool on a season-long loan from Barcelona in August 2026. Liverpool forward Darwin Núñez is named among the attackers.

The wider list adds Rodrigo Bentancur, Lucas Torreira, Giorgian de Arrascaeta, Facundo Pellistri, José María Giménez, Nahitan Nández, and Mathías Olivera.

The 46-man list still needs to be cut to a 26-man traveling roster, and club release approvals could reshape the final group before departure. No timeline for that announcement has been confirmed. For Indian football fans, the October 6 date in Kolkata is the one to watch — a full-strength Uruguay side at Salt Lake Stadium would be a rare fixture on the subcontinent.
facts: Uruguay announced a 46-man provisional squad on September 5, 2026, for an Asia tour that includes friendlies against Japan, South Korea, and India. The match against India is scheduled for October 6 at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan (Salt Lake Stadium) in Kolkata. Diego Forlán, the 2010 FIFA World Cup Golden Ball winner and 2011 Copa América champion, named the squad as part of his debut as Uruguay's senior head coach, replacing Marcelo Bielsa, who resigned after Uruguay exited the group stage at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Real Madrid captain Federico Valverde, 28, a two-time UEFA Champions League winner, is among the top names in the squad and featured in all three of Uruguay's matches at the 2026 World Cup. Defender Ronald Araujo, a three-time La Liga winner, joined Liverpool on a season-long loan from Barcelona in August 2026 and is included in the squad. Forward Darwin Núñez, also a Liverpool player, is named among the forwards in Forlán's selection. Other notable inclusions are Rodrigo Bentancur, Lucas Torreira, Giorgian de Arrascaeta, Facundo Pellistri, José María Giménez, Nahitan Nández, and Mathías Olivera. Since this is only a provisional squad, it is not confirmed which of the 46 players will make the final 26-man traveling roster, subject also to club release approvals.

es.headline: La selección femenina Sub-20 de México abre el Mundial contra Benín
es.dek: México inicia su campaña en el Mundial Femenino Sub-20 contra la debutante Benín en Katowice, Polonia, con 21 jugadoras y la meta de superar los octavos de final.
es.body:
La selección femenina Sub-20 de México arrancó su participación en el Mundial Femenino Sub-20 de la FIFA el sábado 5 de septiembre, enfrentando a Benín en el Arena Katowice, en Polonia. El torneo, que reúne a 24 naciones, se extiende del 5 al 27 de septiembre en cuatro ciudades polacas —Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź y Sosnowiec— con la final programada en Łódź.

México quedó en el Grupo A junto a Polonia, como sede, Argentina y Benín. Benín hace su primera aparición en la historia en un Mundial Femenino Sub-20 de la FIFA, siendo una de las seis naciones debutantes en esta edición. La última participación mundialista de México terminó en los octavos de final en Colombia 2024, marca que el equipo buscará superar.

El técnico Doriva Bueno convocó a 21 jugadoras: 18 provenientes de la Liga MX Femenil y tres que juegan fútbol universitario en Estados Unidos. Tigres encabeza a los clubes mexicanos con más jugadoras seleccionadas, seguido por América y Pachuca con cuatro representantes cada uno. Alice Soto, de Rayadas, y Montserrat Saldívar, de América, aportan experiencia con la selección mayor al grupo.

México llegó a Polonia con impulso. El equipo venció a Ghana 2-1 en un amistoso de preparación previo al inicio del torneo.

Con Benín llegando como novata y Polonia con la energía de su afición local, el Grupo A tiene peso desde el primer silbatazo. México necesita puntos desde temprano para controlar su camino hacia la fase eliminatoria. Los próximos resultados en el Grupo A determinarán cuánta presión cargará el equipo en sus partidos restantes de la fase de grupos.

headline: Mexico women's U-20 side opens World Cup against Benin
dek: Mexico opens its U-20 Women's World Cup campaign against debutant Benin in Katowice, Poland, with 21 players and a Round of 16 to improve on.
body:
Mexico's Under-20 women's national team kicked off its FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup on Saturday, September 5, facing Benin at the Arena Katowice in Poland. The 24-nation tournament runs September 5 to 27 across four Polish cities — Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź, and Sosnowiec — with the final set for Łódź.

Mexico landed in Group A alongside host Poland, Argentina, and Benin. Benin is making its first-ever appearance at a FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup, one of six debutant nations at this edition. Mexico's last World Cup run ended in the Round of 16 at Colombia 2024, a mark the squad will look to surpass.

Coach Doriva Bueno called up 21 players: 18 from Liga MX Femenil and three playing U.S. college soccer. Tigres leads Mexican clubs with the most players selected, followed by América and Pachuca with four representatives each. Alice Soto of Rayadas and Montserrat Saldívar of América bring senior national team experience to the group.

Mexico arrived in Poland with momentum. The squad beat Ghana 2-1 in a preparatory friendly before the tournament opened.

With Benin arriving as first-timers and Poland drawing home-crowd energy, Group A carries weight from the opening whistle. Mexico needs points early to control its path to the knockout rounds. The next results in Group A will determine how much pressure the squad carries into its remaining group matches.

The tournament, which features 24 nations, runs from September 5 to 27 in four Polish cities: Katowice, Bielsko-Biała, Łódź, and Sosnowiec, with the final scheduled in Łódź. Mexico was drawn into Group A alongside host nation Poland, Argentina, and Benin. In their last World Cup appearance at the Colombia 2024 edition, Mexico reached the Round of 16. Prior to the tournament, Mexico defeated Ghana 2-1 in a preparatory friendly.

es.headline: Inter Miami recibe al Atlanta United en choque de temporada regular de la MLS
es.dek: Messi lidera el marcador de la MLS con 18 goles mientras el Inter Miami, campeón defensor, recibe a un Atlanta United en apuros en su encuentro número 20 en la historia entre ambos.
es.body:
El Inter Miami CF recibe al Atlanta United FC el sábado 5 de septiembre en el Nu Stadium de Miami. El partido arranca a las 7:30 PM ET.

El Inter Miami está segundo en la Conferencia del Este con 42 puntos — 12 victorias, seis empates, cuatro derrotas — pero le saca 10 puntos de desventaja al Nashville. Una victoria es casi obligatoria si quieren cerrar esa brecha. El Atlanta United llega en malas condiciones: 21 puntos, seis victorias, tres empates y 13 derrotas, cerca del fondo de la conferencia.

Se espera que Lionel Messi arranque de titular. El argentino lidera el marcador de la MLS con 18 goles en lo que va de temporada. Su última actuación marcó el ritmo — cuatro goles en una paliza de 7-1 al CF Montréal el 29 de agosto. Ese nivel de forma lo convierte en el problema central para cualquier rival.

El técnico del Atlanta United, Gerardo "Tata" Martino, lo sabe mejor que nadie. Martino dirigió a Messi con la selección argentina y ha advertido públicamente a sus jugadores sobre lo que el delantero puede hacer. Si esa advertencia se traduce en un plan defensivo efectivo es otra pregunta. Las 13 derrotas del Atlanta en lo que va de temporada sugieren que el equipo ha tenido dificultades para ejecutar en la mayoría de los partidos.

Este es el primero de dos encuentros de temporada regular programados entre los clubes en 2026 y el vigésimo en la historia entre ambos. El Inter Miami, campeón defensor de la MLS Cup, tiene el incentivo de la tabla y el apoyo de su afición local. Para el Atlanta, el objetivo es limitar el daño y sumar los puntos que pueda en una temporada que en gran medida ha salido mal. Lo que pase a continuación depende en gran medida de si alguien puede frenar a Messi.

perspectives.position: Segundo en la Conferencia del Este con 42 puntos, necesita ganar para acortar la brecha de 10 puntos con el Nashville.
Cerca del fondo de la Conferencia del Este con 21 puntos y 13 derrotas, busca limitar el daño y sumar puntos en una temporada difícil.

Técnico del Atlanta United que conoce de primera mano las capacidades de Messi y ha advertido a sus jugadores, aunque el historial de derrotas del equipo pone en duda la efectividad de cualquier plan.

headline: Inter Miami hosts Atlanta United in MLS regular season clash
dek: Messi leads MLS scoring with 18 goals as defending champion Inter Miami hosts struggling Atlanta United in their 20th all-time meeting.
body:
Inter Miami CF host Atlanta United FC on Saturday, September 5, at Nu Stadium in Miami. Kickoff is 7:30 PM ET.

Inter Miami sit second in the Eastern Conference with 42 points — 12 wins, six draws, four losses — but trail Nashville by 10 points. A win is close to mandatory if they want to close that gap. Atlanta United arrive in rough shape: 21 points, six wins, three draws, and 13 losses, near the bottom of the conference.

Lionel Messi is expected to start. The Argentine leads MLS scoring with 18 goals this season. His last outing set the tone — four goals in a 7-1 demolition of CF Montreal on August 29. That kind of form makes him the central problem for any opponent.

Atlanta United head coach Gerardo "Tata" Martino knows that better than most. Martino coached Messi with the Argentine national team and has publicly warned his players about what the forward can do. Whether that warning translates into an effective defensive plan is another question. Atlanta's 13 losses this season suggest the squad has struggled to execute in most matches.

This is the first of two scheduled regular-season meetings between the clubs in 2026 and the 20th all-time between the two sides. Inter Miami, the defending MLS Cup champions, have the standings incentive and the home crowd. For Atlanta, the goal is damage limitation and collecting any points possible in a season that has largely gone sideways. What happens next depends heavily on whether anyone can slow down Messi.

Inter Miami enter the match second in the Eastern Conference with 42 points from 12 wins, six draws, and four losses. Atlanta United sit near the bottom of the Eastern Conference with 21 points from six wins, three draws, and 13 losses. Argentine forward Lionel Messi is expected to start for Inter Miami; he leads MLS scoring with 18 goals this season, including a four-goal performance in a 7-1 win over CF Montreal on August 29. Atlanta United head coach Gerardo "Tata" Martino has warned his players of Messi's capabilities ahead of the match. Inter Miami are the defending MLS Cup champions and trail Eastern Conference leaders Nashville by 10 points. This is the first of two scheduled regular-season meetings between the clubs in 2026, and the 20th all-time meeting between the two sides.

es.headline: Juez permite que continúe demanda contra Sinema por alienación de afecto
es.dek: Un juez federal dictaminó el 5 de septiembre que la exsenadora Kyrsten Sinema enfrenta juicio bajo la ley de alienación de afecto de Carolina del Norte por su relación con un guardia de seguridad casado.
es.body:
RALEIGH, N.C. — El juez federal David A. Bragdon dictaminó el viernes que la exsenadora Kyrsten Sinema puede ser demandada bajo el estatuto de alienación de afecto de Carolina del Norte, rechazando su moción para desestimar el caso y permitiendo que la demanda presentada por Heather Ammel, residente del condado de Moore, siga adelante.

Sinema, quien representó a Arizona en el Senado de EE.UU. de 2019 a 2025 y actualmente trabaja en el bufete de abogados y cabildeo Hogan Lovells en Washington, reconoció en una declaración jurada del 31 de julio una relación romántica y sexual con Matthew Ammel, un exsoldado del Ejército que se unió a su equipo de seguridad en 2022. Sinema testificó que la relación se volvió sexual el 27 de mayo de 2024, durante un viaje a Napa, California, con encuentros posteriores en Nueva York, Washington, Colorado y Arizona, según documentos judiciales.

Los abogados de Sinema argumentaron que la demanda debe desestimarse porque ella no tiene ningún vínculo significativo con Carolina del Norte y que la relación ocurrió completamente fuera del estado. El juez Bragdon rechazó ese argumento, determinando que nueve mensajes de texto que Sinema envió a Matthew Ammel mientras él se encontraba físicamente en Carolina del Norte establecieron jurisdicción suficiente. El juez también escribió que su "testimonio sobre varios asuntos clave no ha sido creíble", según el Carolina Journal.

La demanda de Heather Ammel alega que Sinema buscó de manera indebida y maliciosa una relación romántica con su esposo sabiendo que él era casado y padre de tres hijos, causando la destrucción de su matrimonio de 14 años. La pareja se separó el 1 de noviembre de 2024 y se divorció en marzo de 2026, según registros judiciales. Heather Ammel presentó originalmente la demanda en el Tribunal Superior del condado de Moore el 30 de septiembre de 2025; el equipo legal de Sinema la trasladó a un tribunal federal después de que Ammel confirmó que buscaba más de $75,000 en daños y perjuicios.

El fallo del viernes no resuelve la disputa de fondo. Carolina del Norte se encuentra entre los pocos estados que aún permiten demandas civiles por alienación de afecto contra terceros acusados de haber interferido intencionalmente en un matrimonio.

perspectives.position: Argumentó que la demanda debe desestimarse porque no tiene ningún vínculo significativo con Carolina del Norte y que su relación con Matthew Ammel ocurrió completamente fuera del estado.

headline: Judge allows alienation-of-affection suit against Sinema to proceed
dek: A federal judge ruled September 5 that former Sen. Kyrsten Sinema faces trial under North Carolina's alienation-of-affection law over her relationship with a married security staffer.
body:
RALEIGH, N.C. — U.S. District Judge David A. Bragdon ruled Friday that former Sen. Kyrsten Sinema may be sued under North Carolina's alienation-of-affection statute, rejecting her motion to dismiss and allowing the case filed by Heather Ammel, a Moore County resident, to proceed.

Sinema, who represented Arizona in the U.S. Senate from 2019 to 2025 and now works at the Washington law and lobbying firm Hogan Lovells, acknowledged in a July 31 deposition a romantic and sexual relationship with Matthew Ammel, a former Army soldier who joined her security detail in 2022. Sinema testified the relationship turned sexual on May 27, 2024, during a trip to Napa, California, with subsequent encounters in New York, Washington, Colorado, and Arizona, according to court filings.

Sinema's attorneys argued the lawsuit must be dismissed because she has no meaningful connection to North Carolina and that the relationship occurred entirely outside the state. Judge Bragdon rejected that argument, finding that nine text messages Sinema sent Matthew Ammel while he was physically present in North Carolina established sufficient jurisdiction. The judge also wrote that her "testimony on several key matters has not been credible," according to the Carolina Journal.

Heather Ammel's lawsuit alleges Sinema wrongfully and maliciously pursued a romantic relationship with her husband knowing he was married with three children, causing the destruction of their 14-year marriage. The couple separated November 1, 2024, and divorced in March 2026, according to court records. Heather Ammel originally filed the suit in Moore County Superior Court on September 30, 2025; Sinema's legal team moved it to federal court after Ammel confirmed she sought more than $75,000 in damages.

Friday's ruling does not resolve the underlying dispute. North Carolina is among a small number of states that still permit alienation-of-affection civil claims against third parties alleged to have intentionally interfered with a marriage.

Kyrsten Sinema can be sued under North Carolina's alienation-of-affection statute, known colloquially as the 'homewrecker' law, over her relationship with a member of her security detail. The lawsuit was filed by Heather Ammel, a Moore County, North Carolina resident and ex-wife of Matthew Ammel, who joined Sinema's security team after retiring from the Army in 2022, according to Heather Ammel's complaint. Sinema acknowledged the romantic and sexual relationship with Matthew Ammel in a July 31 deposition, testifying that it turned sexual on May 27, 2024, during a trip to Napa, California, with subsequent encounters in New York, Washington, Colorado, and Arizona, but not North Carolina, according to court filings. Sinema argued the suit should be dismissed because she has no meaningful connection to North Carolina; Judge Bragdon rejected that argument, finding that nine text messages she sent Ammel while he was in the state established sufficient jurisdiction, and wrote that her 'testimony on several key matters has not been credible,' according to the Carolina Journal. Heather Ammel's lawsuit alleges Sinema pursued Matthew Ammel knowing he was married with three children, causing the destruction of a 14-year marriage; the couple separated November 1, 2024, and divorced in March 2026, according to court records. Heather Ammel filed the suit in Moore County Superior Court on September 30, 2025; Sinema's attorneys moved it to federal court after Ammel confirmed she sought more than $75,000 in damages, per law commentary coverage. North Carolina is one of a small number of states that still permit alienation-of-affection civil claims against third parties alleged to have intentionally interfered with a marriage, according to multiple outlets. Sinema represented Arizona in the U.S. Senate from 2019 to 2025 and now works for the Washington, D.C., law and lobbying firm Hogan Lovells, according to reporting. Friday's ruling does not resolve the underlying dispute but allows the case to proceed.
